properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 23 at 6:06AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
A band of moisture will move through the Interior Monday and
Tuesday, bringing with it warmer air and periods of widespread
rainfall which could approach upwards of an inch for some
locations. Cooling conditions during the  overnight hours,
especially after the system departs, will lead to refreezing of
snow-melt and rain on roadways, creating particularly slick and
slippery conditions.

NWSheadline: REFREEZING SNOW MELT AND RAIN MAY CAUSE SLIPPERY CONDITIONS NEXT WEEK

properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 23 at 6:59AM PDT until October 24 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Pendleton OR
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures of 25 to 30 possible.

* WHERE...Lower Columbia Basin of Oregon and Washington, Foothills of
the Northern Blue Mountains of Oregon, Yakima Valley, and Foothills
of the Blue Mountains of Washington.

* WHEN...From this evening through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

properties.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 23 at 8:59AM CDT until October 23 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to less than one mile.

* WHERE...Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor IL.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM CDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.
properties.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.
